text:
Type: jute border area rug
Use: accent beside a chair or bed; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: rustic, modern, bohemian
Materials: woven jute, flat weave, fringed ends
Colors: charcoal black, natural beige, dark brown
Shape: rectangular, concentric frame blocks with brown center, coarse woven texture, fringe on short ends, small
Feel: earthy, natural, grounded
Goes with: black leather, dark wood floors, natural fibers; rustic or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Jute Area Rug, 3 x 5 Foot, Nuetral Multicolor
product.description: Upgrade your home decor with this striking modern-style rug. Its bold shapes provide a focal point for your room, and its strong but neutral colors are sure to both complement and enhance your existing interior-design theme. 3' x 5' 100% jute Natural jute fibers give this rug a rustic feel. It is handcrafted by Craftmark-certified artisans, helping to preserve the global craft tradition. Flatweave (pile is not applicable) Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
